svg.title: Acting on behalf and the duty check
svg.desc: A delegate approves an item. The module asks Delegations for the actor set, which returns the user and every delegator in that scope. SodGuard checks them all against the compared group. On a clash it writes the block in its own transaction and refuses. Otherwise the module saves the decision with the holder and the delegation number.
